paite: Israel suante lak a pan na sanggampa Aaron leh atapate siampu hi a ka nna aseptheihna ding un la in. Aaron leh atapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar na la ding ahi.
heading: Siampute Puansilh / (Eks 39.1-7)
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

paite: Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in na sanggampa Aaron a ding in puan siangthou bawl in.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

paite: Pilna kha a ka dimsak khutsiam tengteng kiang ah thu gen in, amau Aaron puan, amah hihsianna ding abawltheihna ding un. Huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Apuan bawl ding uh hiaite ahi: Awmtuam, siampu puan, puanaktual, puanakzem, lukhu leh kawnggak. Na sanggampa Aaron a ding leh tapate a ding in puan siangthou abawl ding uh ahi, huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Amau dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih ala ding ua.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

paite: Dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in hoihtak a bawl in, siampu puan abawl ding uhi.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

paite: Aliang nihte gei nihte akimat ding ua; akimatkhawm ding uhi.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

paite: Siampu puanakzem gakna, puanduang kawnggak dangka-eng khau toh khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au siamtak a gat puanmalngat in abawl ding uh ahi.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Onik suang nih na la dia, huaite tung ah Israel suante min na gelh ding ahi.
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

paite: Suang khat tung ah aminte uh lak a guk, suang dang tung ah, a-omlaite min guk dangte, apiandan bang zel un na gelh ding ahi.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

paite: Suainamna zungbuh khuakthoh a kigelh bang in, suangmantam khuakthoh agelhsiamte gelh, huai suangmantam nihte ah Israel tapate min na gelh ding a, huai suangmantamte dangka-eng khuak sung ah na phum ding ahi.
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

paite: Huai suang nihte Israel suante a ding a theihgigena suang hi ding in siampu puan liangzang ah na koih ding. Huchi in theihgigena ding in Aaron in aliangzang nihte tung ah TOUPA ma ah aminte uh apo ding hi.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

paite: Dangka-eng bulhna na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make settings of gold,

paite: Amongte a dangka-engtak khainiang nihte; pakkhi bang in na bawl dia, akibulhnate ah pakkhi bang khainiangte na khih ding ahi.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

paite: Vaihawmna omtuamna siamtak in na bawl dia; siampu puan bawl bang in na bawl ding, dangka-eng in, adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in, na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Awmtuamna / (Eks 39.8-21)
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

paite: Khep nih in akikhep dia, akhep adung-avai kikim, khap khat a sau leh khap khat a za ahi ding ahi.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

paite: Huaite tung ah suang vual li in suangmantamte na bulh dia: avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang ahi ding. Hiai avual khatna ahi ding hi.
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

paite: Avual nihna emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond suang ahi ding ahi.
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

paite: Avual thumna liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi ding.
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

paite: Avual lina beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi ding hi. Abulhna ua dangka- eng bulh ding ahi.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

paite: Suangte Israel suante min toh akithuah dia, amin uh dungzui in sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhte bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte dungzui in ahi ding uhi.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

paite: Awmtuam tung ah pakkhi bang a bawl amongte ah dangka-eng siang khainiang na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

paite: Awmtuam tung ah dangka-eng sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai sikkual nihte awmtuam mong nihte tung ah na koih ding hi.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

paite: Awmtuam mongte tung a om sikkual nihte ah dangka-eng pakkhi bang nihte na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

paite: Pakkhi bang khainiang nihte mong nih dangte bulhna nihte ah na khih dia, ama a siampu puan liangzangte ah na koih ding hi.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai gei a siampu puan mong nihte tung ah na koih ding; asunglam a siampu puan gei a om pen ah.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual dang nihte na bawl dia, siampu puan gei nihte nuailam a atung ah na koih ding, amalam sang a akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puan konggak lamdang tungtak ah.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Asikkual in awmtuam siampu puan sikkual ah puanduang dum toh na hen dia, huchi a siampu puan kawnggak lamdang tung a a-omtheihna ding in leh siampu puan a pan awmtuam akiphellouhna ding in.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

paite: Aaron in, TOUPA ma a theihgigena hiden ding a, mun siangthou a alut chiang in, alungtang zawntak ah vaihawmna awmtuam tung ah Israel suante minte apo ding hi.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

paite: Vaihawmna awmtuam ah Urim leh Thummim na koih ding. TOUPA ma a ava lut chiang in, Aaron lungtang zawn ah a-om ding hi. Huchi in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah alungtang zawntak ah Israel suante vaihawmna apo gige ding hi.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

paite: Siampu puan puanaktual adum in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Siampu Kivatna Dangte / (Eks 39.22-31)
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

paite: Akhung ah a-awng a-om dia; alaitak a, a-awng kimvel ah gatthoh khihna a-om dia, siklen puanak ban nei lou hileh kilawm ahi ding, akeklouhna ding in.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

paite: Huai puanaktual mong ah adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in na bawl dia, agei kimvel in. Dangka-eng dakte akimvel in akikal zel uah na bawl ding ahi.
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

paite: Dangka-eng dak leh theibuhfai puanaktual gei tung ah akivel in a-om ding ahi.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

paite: Aaron in nna asep chiang in huai asilh ding hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a Mun Siangthou a alut chiang leh ahong pawt chiang in aging akiza dia, asi kei chih theihna ding in.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.

paite: Dangka-engtak in kuang na bawl dia, atung ah na gelh ding, suainamna zungbuh bang a khuak in, TOUPA A DIA SIANTHOUNA chih na gelh ding ahi.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

paite: Huai laigelhna sikpek siampu dialkhip a, amailam ah khau dum in na khihbelh ding ahi.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

paite: Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om dia, ama'n Israelte thillat siangthou toh kisai a, Israel suante khelhna apo ding ahi. Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om gige dia, thillat siangthoute TOUPA mai ah san ahi ding hi.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

paite: Puanmalngat hoih puanak na gan dia, puanmalngat in lukhu na bawl dia, agatthoh in kawnggak na bawl ding hi.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

paite: Aaron tapate a ding in puanakte na bawl dia, kawnggakte na bawlsak ding. Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in lukhute amau a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

paite: Huaite na sanggampa Aaron tung ah leh akiang a atapate tung ah na koih dia; amaute thau na nilh dia, na septuam dia, na siansak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding un.
english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Avuaktanna uh khuh ding in puan pheituam zumte na bawlsak dia; atai a pan aphei chiang atun ding uh ahi.
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a alut chiang un hiam ahihkeileh Mun Siangthou a nasem dia dohkan kiang a, ahong pai chiang un, khelhna khatpeuh neih ziak a asihlouhna ding un huaite asa tung uah a-om gige ding ahi. Huchi in huai amah a ding leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
